Analysis: Both hypotheses present an innovative integration of metabolic regulation and immune modulation in HCC. However, Hypothesis 1 is slightly superior because it specifically targets CD8+ T cells, which are the main drivers of antitumor immunity, and explicitly references PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors, a well-established clinical strategy. This specificity improves both the mechanistic clarity and testability of the hypothesis, as focused experiments can be designed to monitor LDLR-mediated TCR recycling in CD8+ T cells. Although both hypotheses are novel and raise similar safety considerations, the detailed cell-type focus in Hypothesis 1 makes it more plausible and experimentally tractable.
